description: Incident Response Queries — Organized by Attack Phase

queries.name: Failed SSH Logins
queries.desc: Brute force attempt indicator
queries.sql: SELECT address, COUNT(*) AS failed_attempts, datetime(MAX(time),'unixepoch') AS last_attempt FROM user_events WHERE message LIKE '%Failed%' OR message LIKE '%Invalid user%' OR message LIKE '%authentication failure%' GROUP BY address HAVING failed_attempts > 3 ORDER BY failed_attempts DESC;

queries.name: Successful Logins
queries.desc: All successful authentication events
queries.sql: SELECT uid, message, address, terminal, datetime(time,'unixepoch') AS event_time FROM user_events WHERE message LIKE '%Accepted%' OR message LIKE '%session opened%' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20;

queries.name: New Web Files
queries.desc: Recently created files in web directories
queries.sql: SELECT path, filename, uid, mode, size, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified FROM file WHERE (path LIKE '/var/www/%%' OR path LIKE '/srv/www/%%') AND mtime > (strftime('%s','now') - 86400) AND type = 'regular' ORDER BY mtime DESC;

queries.name: Shell Spawned by Server
queries.desc: Web shell execution — highest severity
queries.sql: SELECT child.pid, child.name AS shell, child.cmdline, parent.name AS spawned_by, parent.path, datetime(child.start_time,'unixepoch') AS started FROM processes AS child JOIN processes AS parent ON child.parent = parent.pid WHERE child.name IN ('bash','sh','zsh','dash','fish','ksh') AND parent.name IN ('apache2','nginx','php','php-fpm','python','python3','ruby','node','java','tomcat');

queries.name: Suspicious Process Execution
queries.desc: Processes with dangerous command patterns
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, path, cmdline, uid, datetime(start_time,'unixepoch') AS started FROM processes WHERE cmdline LIKE '%/dev/tcp/%' OR cmdline LIKE '%base64 -d%' OR cmdline LIKE '%curl%bash%' OR cmdline LIKE '%wget%bash%' OR cmdline LIKE '%-i >& /dev/%' ORDER BY start_time DESC;

queries.name: Interpreter Processes
queries.desc: Python, Perl, Ruby processes currently running
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, path, cmdline, uid, datetime(start_time,'unixepoch') AS started FROM processes WHERE name IN ('python','python3','perl','ruby','php','lua','node') ORDER BY start_time DESC;

queries.name: Cron Jobs
queries.desc: All cron job files and their owners
queries.sql: SELECT path, filename, uid, mode, size, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified FROM file WHERE (path LIKE '/etc/cron.d/%' OR path LIKE '/var/spool/cron/crontabs/%' OR path LIKE '/etc/cron.daily/%' OR path LIKE '/etc/cron.hourly/%' OR path LIKE '/etc/cron.weekly/%') AND type = 'regular' ORDER BY mtime DESC;

queries.name: Systemd Services
queries.desc: All systemd service files
queries.sql: SELECT path, filename, uid, mode, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified FROM file WHERE (path LIKE '/etc/systemd/system/%' OR path LIKE '/lib/systemd/system/%') AND filename LIKE '%.service' AND type = 'regular' ORDER BY mtime DESC LIMIT 30;

queries.name: SSH Authorized Keys
queries.desc: SSH backdoor keys across all users
queries.sql: SELECT path, uid, gid, mode, size, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified, datetime(atime,'unixepoch') AS last_accessed FROM file WHERE path LIKE '/home/%/.ssh/authorized_keys' OR path = '/root/.ssh/authorized_keys' ORDER BY mtime DESC;

queries.name: Startup Scripts
queries.desc: Shell init and profile script state
queries.sql: SELECT path, filename, uid, mode, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified FROM file WHERE (path LIKE '/etc/profile.d/%' OR path = '/etc/rc.local' OR path LIKE '/home/%/.bashrc' OR path LIKE '/home/%/.bash_profile' OR path = '/root/.bashrc' OR path = '/root/.bash_profile') AND type = 'regular' ORDER BY mtime DESC;

queries.name: SUID Binaries
queries.desc: All SUID set binaries — privilege escalation risk
queries.sql: SELECT path, filename, uid, mode, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified FROM file WHERE (path LIKE '/usr/bin/%' OR path LIKE '/bin/%' OR path LIKE '/usr/local/bin/%' OR path LIKE '/tmp/%') AND mode LIKE '4%' AND type = 'regular' ORDER BY mtime DESC;

queries.name: Backdoor Root Accounts
queries.desc: Accounts with UID=0 other than root
queries.sql: SELECT username, uid, gid, shell, directory, description FROM users WHERE uid = 0 AND username != 'root';

queries.name: Sudo Group Members
queries.desc: All users with sudo privileges
queries.sql: SELECT users.username, users.uid, groups.groupname FROM user_groups JOIN users ON user_groups.uid = users.uid JOIN groups ON user_groups.gid = groups.gid WHERE groups.groupname IN ('sudo','wheel','admin') ORDER BY users.username;

queries.name: Docker Group Members
queries.desc: Docker group members — trivial root escalation path
queries.sql: SELECT users.username, users.uid FROM user_groups JOIN users ON user_groups.uid = users.uid JOIN groups ON user_groups.gid = groups.gid WHERE groups.groupname = 'docker';

queries.name: Root Processes from Non-Standard Paths
queries.desc: Root processes not in standard system directories
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, path, cmdline, datetime(start_time,'unixepoch') AS started FROM processes WHERE uid = 0 AND path != '' AND path NOT LIKE '/usr/%' AND path NOT LIKE '/bin/%' AND path NOT LIKE '/sbin/%' AND path NOT LIKE '/lib/%' AND path NOT LIKE '/opt/%' ORDER BY start_time DESC;

queries.name: Sudoers File Integrity
queries.desc: Hash of sudoers file — detect unauthorized changes
queries.sql: SELECT path, md5, sha256 FROM hash WHERE path = '/etc/sudoers' OR path LIKE '/etc/sudoers.d/%';

queries.name: Deleted But Running Binaries
queries.desc: Processes whose executable was deleted from disk
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, path, uid, cmdline, datetime(start_time,'unixepoch') AS started FROM processes WHERE path LIKE '% (deleted)%' ORDER BY start_time DESC;

queries.name: LD_PRELOAD Injection
queries.desc: Library injection — rootkit indicator
queries.sql: SELECT p.pid, p.name, p.path, e.value AS ld_preload, u.username FROM process_envs AS e JOIN processes AS p ON e.pid = p.pid JOIN users AS u ON p.uid = u.uid WHERE e.key = 'LD_PRELOAD' AND e.value != '';

queries.name: Critical Binary Hashes
queries.desc: Hashes of key system tools — detect trojaned binaries
queries.sql: SELECT f.path, f.size, datetime(f.mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified, h.md5, h.sha256 FROM file AS f JOIN hash AS h ON f.path = h.path WHERE f.path IN ('/bin/bash','/bin/ls','/bin/ps','/usr/bin/sudo','/usr/bin/ssh','/usr/bin/who','/bin/find','/usr/bin/top','/usr/bin/last') ORDER BY f.path;

queries.name: Kernel Module Anomalies
queries.desc: Modules with non-Live status — rootkit indicator
queries.sql: SELECT name, size, status, address FROM kernel_modules WHERE status != 'Live' OR size = 0 ORDER BY name;

queries.name: SSH Key Files
queries.desc: All SSH private and public key files
queries.sql: SELECT path, uid, mode, size, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified FROM file WHERE path LIKE '%/.ssh/%' AND (filename LIKE 'id_%' OR filename LIKE '%.pub') ORDER BY mtime DESC;

queries.name: Known Hosts Files
queries.desc: SSH known_hosts — reveals outbound SSH targets
queries.sql: SELECT path, uid, size, datetime(atime,'unixepoch') AS last_accessed, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified FROM file WHERE path LIKE '%/.ssh/known_hosts' ORDER BY atime DESC;

queries.name: Outbound SSH Connections
queries.desc: Active connections on port 22 outbound
queries.sql: SELECT p.name, p.pid, p.cmdline, s.remote_address, s.remote_port, datetime(p.start_time,'unixepoch') AS started FROM process_open_sockets AS s JOIN processes AS p ON s.pid = p.pid WHERE s.remote_port = 22 AND s.action = 'connect' AND s.family = 2 AND s.remote_address != '127.0.0.1';

queries.name: Credential File Access
queries.desc: Processes touching credential files
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, path, cmdline, uid FROM processes WHERE cmdline LIKE '%/etc/shadow%' OR cmdline LIKE '%id_rsa%' OR cmdline LIKE '%/.aws/credentials%' OR cmdline LIKE '%/.gnupg/%' ORDER BY pid;

queries.name: Reverse Shell Candidates
queries.desc: Interpreters with active external connections
queries.sql: SELECT p.pid, p.name, p.path, p.cmdline, s.remote_address, s.remote_port FROM processes AS p JOIN process_open_sockets AS s ON p.pid = s.pid WHERE p.name IN ('bash','sh','nc','ncat','netcat','python','python3','perl','ruby') AND s.state = 'ESTABLISHED' AND s.family = 2 AND s.remote_address != '127.0.0.1';

queries.name: Connections to C2 Ports
queries.desc: Connections to known attacker-used ports
queries.sql: SELECT p.name, p.pid, s.remote_address, s.remote_port FROM process_open_sockets AS s JOIN processes AS p ON s.pid = p.pid WHERE s.remote_port IN (4444,4445,1337,1338,9001,9002,2222,3333,5555,6666,7777,8888) AND s.state = 'ESTABLISHED' AND s.family = 2;

queries.name: Unusual DNS Resolvers
queries.desc: DNS servers not in common trusted list
queries.sql: SELECT type, address FROM dns_resolvers WHERE address NOT IN ('8.8.8.8','8.8.4.4','1.1.1.1','1.0.0.1','9.9.9.9','208.67.222.222') AND type = 'nameserver';

queries.name: High Disk Write Processes
queries.desc: Processes writing large amounts of data
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, path, uid, ROUND(disk_bytes_written/1048576.0,2) AS mb_written, ROUND(disk_bytes_read/1048576.0,2) AS mb_read FROM processes WHERE disk_bytes_written > 10485760 ORDER BY disk_bytes_written DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.name: Archive Creation
queries.desc: tar/zip operations on sensitive directories
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, cmdline, uid FROM processes WHERE (cmdline LIKE '%tar %' OR cmdline LIKE '%zip %') AND (cmdline LIKE '%/etc/%' OR cmdline LIKE '%/home/%' OR cmdline LIKE '%passwd%' OR cmdline LIKE '%shadow%') ORDER BY pid;

queries.name: Upload Activity
queries.desc: curl or wget upload operations
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, cmdline, uid FROM processes WHERE (cmdline LIKE '%curl%' OR cmdline LIKE '%wget%') AND (cmdline LIKE '%-T %' OR cmdline LIKE '%--upload%' OR cmdline LIKE '%-X POST%' OR cmdline LIKE '%--data%') ORDER BY pid;
